mentions.name: Kraa
mentions.description: Kraa is a web-based markdown editor that handles notes, collaborative documents, todos, long stories, chats, and communities. It combines a minimal UI with plentiful features, including real-real-time chat and quick community creation, and deliberately includes no AI integrations.
mentions.problem: The markdown editor space is crowded, with few editors combining a minimal UI, plentiful features, and real real-time chat in one tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: Web-based markdown editor that can handle notes, colab documents, todos, long stories, as well as chats or communities.

evidence.value: Web-based markdown editor that can handle notes, colab documents, todos, long stories, as well as chats or communities.
